text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука sounds half asleep as she
murmurs
under her breath.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yawn... A trip would be... so nice...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Rolling plains carpeted with verdant
grass, and
auroras dancing above in the
sky...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've been watching videos of scenery
taken from
all around the world recently.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
My legs tingle just thinking about those
vistas...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Sigh... But before I knew it, it was already morning.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems Сайленс Судзука was so
enthralled by the
videos, it cut into her
sleЭпизод She certainly looks a
little tired.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
